summary: sequence parameters: count (not with end), end, format (default %d), start (default 1), and stride (default 1, or -1 if end < start).
questions: How do I count down with with_sequence?
What's the default start of with_sequence?
Can I use count and end together?

answer_card.title: sequence lookup parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `start` (default 1)
- `end`: don't combine with `count`
- `count`: number of elements; don't combine with `end`
- `stride` (default 1, or -1 if end < start)
- `format` (default `%d`)
